column1: # Every claim of AGENTS.md §11's required-coverage list, mapped to the evidence
# `bullet` is the item's position in §11's list, 1-17. `claim` is a short key
# and text. `evidence` is a comma-separated list, each item of the form
# A subtest is written /<name>, and the top-level test must be declared.
# `gap` is empty, or "known-gap: <what is missing end to end>", which must
# also be a "§11 <key>" line in docs/PROOFS.md §12.
# TestSection11Coverage (test/tools/proofrun) reads this file: the bullets must
# match AGENTS.md, every test must be declared in its package, the kind must
# match the file's build tag, and every claim needs non-unit evidence that runs
# in the merge gate or a known-gap row.

column2: 1a Orker termination while a container runs
column5: the killed Orker's heartbeats stop, Temporal retries the activity, and a replacement reaps its container

column2: 1b Orker termination after its container exits
column5: the upload is held after the container exits, the Orker is killed, and the retry runs the container again

column2: 1c Orker termination during artifact upload
column5: one artifact is complete and the second upload is in flight when the Orker is killed

column2: 1d Orker termination after commit.json, before Temporal completion
column5: every retry adopts the durable commit and runs no container

column2: 2a Orker restart
column5: the replacement identity is the one the predecessor used, so the reaper matches

column2: 2b Temporary object-storage failure
column5: a cut at the engine's switch and a definition load, and at a cache memo

column2: 2b-orker Temporary object-storage failure at the Orker's own upload/commit
column5: the store refuses uploads and then commits for two attempts each; the retry follows the policy and never reports a silent success

column2: 2c Temporary Temporal failure
column5: the frontend cut covers every worker's connection, the Orkers' included; a dedicated Orker-only cut is a named follow-up, not a coverage gap

column2: 3a Exit 1
column5: CONTAINER_EXIT_NONZERO and the attempt record carry the exit code

column2: 3b Exit 0 without values.json
column5: VALUES_MISSING is a ContractViolation

column2: 3c Malformed JSON
column5: VALUES_MALFORMED is a ContractViolation

column2: 3d Output-size excess
column5: the fixture runs a real container through the dispatcher on the proof's own images

column2: 3e Timeout
column5: CONTAINER_TIMEOUT with the TimedOut category

column2: 3f Cancellation
column5: Temporal cancellation reaches the container and stops a sibling

column2: 3g Ignored SIGTERM
column5: the trap '' TERM workload ends only by SIGKILL after the grace period

column2: 3h Unavailable input artifact
column5: the artifact is deleted while an await is open; the task fails INPUT_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE on both attempts, with no container

column2: 3i Failed image pull: the reason
column5: a real foreign-platform index produces IMAGE_PULL_FAILED

column2: 3i-retry Failed image pull: retry per policy
column5: a foreign-platform index is served and unpullable; two attempts fail IMAGE_PULL_FAILED per the task's retry and the run ends FAILED

column2: 3j A tag changing between executions
column4: known-gap: no run moves an image tag between two attempts
column5: the digest is pinned at apply, so a moved tag never reaches a stored version by design

column2: 4 Pin on one Orker among three, no failover
column5: three real pin hosts; twenty round trips stay on one, and survivors are never handed the lost host's tasks

column2: 5 Pin host lost between two members
column5: the committed member stays SUCCEEDED with its commit, values ref and artifact bytes

column2: 6a Pinned attempt wrote commit.json then died
column5: the retry adopts the commit instead of running the container

column2: 6b Pinned retry after a non-committing failure sees /orkstack/shared
column5: the shared directory survives the failed attempt

column2: 7 Run terminated from outside while a pin is open
column5: no workflow code runs, so the lease sweep is the only collector, and only after expiry

column2: 8 Every pin host saturated
column5: PIN_UNAVAILABLE only after the full creation timeout, no pin directory, the holder undisturbed

column2: 9 Worker Deployment Version rollout while a pin is open
column5: the pin's members stay on the opening process, and unpinned tasks keep their own routing

column2: 10a A failing run's handlers run to their outcomes; the run still fails
column5: the original reason survives the handlers' own outcomes

column2: 10b Operator cancel starts no handler and stops running ones
column5: a cancel before any failure starts none; during handlers it keeps the run failed

column2: 10c An Orker killed under a running handler retries it per its policy
column5: retry follows the handler's own policy, including none

column2: 11a Continue-as-new with tasks running: no cancel, no double dispatch, no gap
column5: the switch waits for the last task and the stream is contiguous

column2: 11b A fan-out whose items outlast any fixed window still switches
column5: items in flight for hours of workflow clock still switch

column2: 11c A budget crossed by history bytes switches and is guarded
column5: a bytes-driven switch and a bytes-driven guard ending FAILED

column2: 12a Orker killed during a hold
column5: the hold releases only after the retry finishes

column2: 12b A resolution racing the switch
column5: the resolution is applied exactly once

column2: 12c An operator cancel racing the switch
column5: RUN_CANCELED in the generation reached, with no successor

column2: 12d Engine replica killed mid-hold
column5: the replacement replica continues the run

column2: 12e Replica killed between the switch's writes and its commit
column5: the next generation starts from the committed state alone

column2: 12f Replica killed right after a switch
column5: one run id and a contiguous stream

column2: 12g Temporal frontend unreachable during the switch
column5: the run completes after the frontend returns

column2: 12h Temporal frontend unreachable during the next start
column5: the start retries and completes

column2: 12i Version rollout while a chain switches
column5: v1 never reads as gone until the chain ends

column2: 12j One run id and a contiguous stream
column5: every chaos test reads the run through requireOneRunRead

column2: 12k No late write overwrites a newer snapshot
column5: the late write lands on its own content key

column2: 12l No release, namespace or deletion count reads the run as gone
column5: RunningCount, ListRuns and the deletion gate always see the run

column2: 13a An await crossing a switch fires at its original instant
column5: the deadline is an absolute instant carried in the checkpoint

column2: 13b An await accepts a resolution after the switch
column5: the resolution lands in the next generation

column2: 13c An open pin finishes on its host before the run switches
column5: the switch waits for the pin

column2: 13d A pin waiting on an await gives the hold up
column5: the hold gives up only when the pin's remaining work waits on an await

column2: 13e A pin host lost during a hold fails PIN_HOST_LOST
column5: the run fails explicitly, never re-opened elsewhere

column2: 13f A composed child in flight holds the switch
column5: the child finishes before the switch

column2: 14a A saved state corrupted, missing, malformed or of an unknown format
column5: each ends explicitly with a RUN_STATE_* code

column2: 14b Operator cancel during the start
column5: the cancel reaches while a read is blocked and ends RUN_CANCELED

column2: 14c Terminal event from the exact state at the switch, plus an archive body
column5: each assertion reads the terminal snapshot and the archive body

column2: 14d A failing start stays within its stated history bound
column5: the whole generation stays under RestoreHistoryBound

column2: 15a An earlier generation's history deleted while the run continues
column5: GetRun, events and the archive stay complete

column2: 15b The projection worker down during the switch
column5: the run's stream is complete when the projection returns

column2: 15c An event segment lost before archiving leaves an explicit gap
column5: the archive and the evidence bundle name the gap; the run is never missing

column2: 16a A run that can never go idle fails RUN_HISTORY_LIMIT before the cluster's limit
column5: the guard's shapes test validates every reserve constant

column2: 16b Object storage unavailable at a switch never yields a switch without its objects
column5: no switch without its objects, and no silent success

column2: 16c A saved state over its bound never switches
column5: just above the cap it switches in bounded chunks; just below it ends RUN_HISTORY_LIMIT naming the size

column2: 16d A run with more work than its in-flight cap never exceeds the pending limit and never stalls
column5: no PENDING_ACTIVITIES_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, no stall with nothing in flight

column2: 17a The task ceiling completes across generations with its definition by reference and overlays on
column5: the merge gate proves it at 1,000 tasks (below the default 4,000) across at least two generations; the default ceiling itself is the deferred soak TestIntegration_SoakTasks

column2: 17b The item ceiling completes across generations with its definition by reference and overlays on
column5: the merge gate proves it at 4,000 items (below the default 10,000) across at least two generations; the default ceiling itself is the deferred soak TestIntegration_SoakItemCeilingByReferenceWithOverlays
